title: File access built from input (matlab) — review required
description: A matlab file operation builds its path from input: fopen(dir + f). Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via fullfile plus prefix check.
remediation: Confine with fullfile plus prefix check or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
